subject: Private deployment maintenance: dependency quarantine & rollback scenarios
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@hearthbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@hearthbank.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming Private cluster upgrades — coordination request

Hi Vanessa,

We have a vendor-mandated patch window coming up for the private VPC cluster Redwood manages for HearthBank. The bank's security team requires: version pinning for the inference runtime during the window, an isolated "dependency quarantine" for nodes that will be updated, and clear rollback procedures if model behavior regresses.

Key constraints:
- Maintenance window target: any 3-4 hour window between 7pm–2am PT on weekdays (minimize customer impact).
- No cross-tenant cache invalidation unless scoped to the bank's KV namespace.
- A list of exact artifacts you will touch (binaries, container images, kernel/driver updates).

Can you put together a proposed run-of-show (sequence of steps, canary criteria, rollback triggers) and include any gating we need to sign off on from our side? Procurement is copied for scheduling.

Attached: HearthBank_req_2026-06.pdf (regulatory checklist).

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen
Sr. Cloud Ops Manager — HearthBank

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@hearthbank.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Private cluster upgrades — coordination request

Emily — thanks for the note and the checklist. We've scoped this with the infra team and put together a proposed approach that addresses version pinning, node quarantine, and clear rollback gates. High level:

- Proposed window: Wed 2026-07-08 23:00–02:00 PT (3 hrs) — low traffic per your telemetry.
- Version pinning: we will pin the inference runtime and model-serving components for HearthBank's tenant to the prior stable build until the canary passes; this prevents an accidental cross-tenant model drift.
- Dependency quarantine: update a 3-node canary in an isolated subnet with no external traffic (quarantine). If telemetry and end-to-end prompts show no regressions at 30m and 90m, roll the remainder in 3-wave batches.
- Rollback triggers: Token rejection rates >0.5%, response latency >2x baseline for >15m, or eval prompt regressions (we will run the provided regression set).
- KV cache strategy: do not flush global caches. We will drain and warm Canary's cache only.

I've attached a spreadsheet with the proposed windows and contact roster: redwood_proposed_window_20260630.xlsx. Dev — can you add the detailed runbook steps and the exact sequence for dependency quarantine + network changes?

I'll schedule a 30-minute pre-maint call for next Wednesday to walk through.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Manager — Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Private cluster upgrades — coordination request

Team — details below for the runbook; sending to Emily for visibility. I also attached the quarantine-playbook.md and rollback-checklist.txt. 

Runbook (sequence):
1) Pre-checks (T-2h): backup KV snapshots for hearthbank_namespace, verify snapshot integrity, confirm console metrics ingestion.
2) Quarantine setup (T-1h): allocate an isolated 3-node pool in the same VPC but in a dedicated subnet. Apply security group with no external ingress and limited egress to telemetry collection endpoints only.
3) Canary deploy (T-45m): pull images to quarantine nodes, validate container signatures, start services with pinned artifacts (image tags + sha256).
4) Canary smoke (T-30m): run functional smoke tests (auth, respond latency <100ms p50, model eval pass rate >= 98%). Run HearthBank's regression set (provided) automatically.
5) Monitor & hold (T+30m, T+90m): hold at 30m. If all gates pass, continue to wave 1. Each wave is ~30–45m with parallel drain/warm steps.
6) Network changes: minimal — no BGP changes. We will add temporary firewall allow rules for telemetry only, then remove them in the final wave. All changes are documented in the attached playbook.

Rollback procedure (short):
- Immediate rollback will re-pin the tenant back to the previous runtime image tag and re-establish KV key snapshots (restore point).
- If a rollback occurs during wave, we will redact the new images from the registry and trigger a controlled restart.
- For full-cluster rollback, we will revert in the reverse wave order and notify HearthBank procurement and our on-call.

Gating metrics (automated):
- Error rate delta >0.5% absolute
- Latency spike p95 >2x baseline for >15m
- Regression suite failure rate >1% or any deterministic hallucination in the bank-critical prompts

Notes: we are recommending a read-only maintenance banner for affected endpoints (internal) and a 15-minute customer notice window in case we need to extend.

Attachments: quarantine-playbook.md, rollback-checklist.txt

- Dev
